entry.title: Patience Is Priced, Scarcity Is Scarce, and Beta Is Rationed

entry.title: Tightening Bounds, Compressing Risk: The Portfolio's Shift to Liquidity, and the Macro Fractures Behind the Move
entry.summary: Macro Monitor (October 14, 2026). Analyzes the walk-forward portfolio transition into risk-free liquidity (SHV at 31.1%, 2.67% annualized volatility) and maps the underlying cross-asset fractures via an OWL/SKOS macroeconomic ontology.

entry.title: When a Portfolio Becomes a Market Barometer
